verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Agent Flows, a no-code way to build agent skills, plus custom skills and a developer API. None of it describes scheduling recurring jobs, cron-like triggers or timed workflow runs. Building flows is adjacent to this story, and the API is only a building block that a user could drive from an external scheduler; neither counts as a scheduling capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
